definitions.explanation: The academic field and science of medicine.

examples.japanese: {医学|いがく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}ぶ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。
⟦{医学部|いがくぶ}→医学部：27620_igakubu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}りたい→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: I want to enter medical school.

examples.japanese: {医学|いがく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{進歩|しんぽ}→進歩：03265_shinpo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{早|はや}い→早い：00514_hayai⟧。
examples.english: Advances in medical science are very fast.

notes:
{医学|いがく} refers to medical science as an academic discipline — the study and science of medicine, not medicine as a substance.

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{医学部|いがくぶ}→医学部：27620_igakubu⟧: medical school/department
- ⟦{医学生|いがくせい}→医学生：27621_igakusei⟧: medical student
- ⟦{医学者|いがくしゃ}→医学者：noentry⟧: medical scientist
- ⟦{医学的|いがくてき}→医学的：noentry⟧: medical (adjective, as in ⟦{医学的|いがくてき}→医学的：noentry⟧⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{根拠|こんきょ}→根拠：10147_konkyo⟧, medical evidence)

RELATED FIELDS:
- ⟦{歯学|しがく}→歯学：27622_shigaku⟧: dentistry
- ⟦{薬学|やくがく}→薬学：19156_yakugaku⟧: pharmacy/pharmaceutical science
- ⟦{獣医学|じゅういがく}→獣医学：20887_juuigaku⟧: veterinary medicine

IMPORTANT DISTINCTION:
{医学|いがく} = medical science (the field). For "medicine" as in medication/drugs, use ⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧ or ⟦{医薬品|いやくひん}→医薬品：19711_iyakuhin⟧.
